authorization.scope: three official Ofgem pre-levelised energy price cap workbooks spanning 2024, 2025, and 2026, for aggregate-only OOXML safety, formula-topology, and capacity inspection
authorization.basis: Ofgem-published Crown copyright material is reusable under the Open Government Licence unless otherwise indicated; this is a technical preflight, not a legal opinion

research_question: Can three official Ofgem pre-levelised price-cap workbooks support a source-authentic, formula-DAG task with exact 32K, 64K, and 128K contexts after formula-template deduplication and deterministic recalculation checks?
constraints: document properties, comments, people metadata, images, and external relationship targets are never training text
formula-template capacity replaces A1-style cell coordinates and removes cached values from formula units while preserving sheet names, operators, functions, and literal constants
cached values from unavailable external workbooks are boundary observations, not independently recomputed ground truth
embedded Internal Only print-header markers are excluded from capacity and require an explicit rights review before any derived training-text redistribution
no candidate generation until a network-disabled deterministic oracle validates an explicitly self-contained formula subgraph in both openpyxl and LibreOffice
no capacity claim may count repeated copied formula templates as unique semantic content
no near-duplicate, exact-band, derived-view, truncation, source-lineage, or remove-one gate may be relaxed
